items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: Professor Moneta tells about his brother, Norm, was it his brother?

ctx.x: in the band during that time. Do you remember who was playing baritone horn? Baritone horn? They had a fella called Frank. Frank Joseph, he was playing, he's dead now. Yeah, he was a cook, he used to cook on the clubs out there. He used to cook on what? He used to cook on one of those boats out there on the river. Oh yeah? Yeah. He was a little short fella. He had one of those upright bass. I mean a valet horn, yeah. Then finally after he passed away too. Late, before Mount Allen died he had a, this fella he's…

You remember when you were a boy, the real old band Professor Moneta tells about his brother, Norm, was it his brother? Yeah. Or his uncle. His uncle had a brass band way back. That would be when you were. No, I don't know. See, he's

way older than what I am, you know. Yeah, he's. I don't remember. It was Pacific brass band. Oh, the Pacific, yeah, I remember that. Remember Pacific? Oh yeah, I remember that. That's way back, isn't it? That's way back. I was nothing but a young kid then. Uh-huh. I used to go around listening to that. On that street called the Almas Street. It was in the four, five, in the six on the block. About there. The Almas? The Almas, yeah. They used to rehearse for that. The fella used to have been in a band. He used to,…
